description: VECTOR_MAX - every expectation measured on a real Snowflake account. The maximum is ELEMENT-WISE, not row-wise: over [1,9,3], [4,5,-6] and [7,2,0] the answer is [7.000000,9.000000,3.000000], with each element taken from a different row. NULL rows are skipped. Unlike VECTOR_AVG it KEEPS the INT element type, which is why the INT case renders [4,9,3] rather than [4.000000,9.000000,3.000000]. An empty or all-NULL group is NULL, a single-row group is that row, and a non-vector argument is the compile error 'Invalid argument types for function VECTOR_MAX: (NUMBER(1,0))'. Converted 1:1 from functions/vector/VectorMaxTest (now retired); every vector is read as a bare cell, as recorded in functions-vector-avg.
